name: Wen Acquisition Corp Unit
summary: WEN Acquisition Corp functions as a Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC), established with the goal of completing a business combination, such as a merger or acquisition, with one or more target entities. The company's strategic emphasis is on infrastructure firms within the financial technology (FinTech) sector. It specifically seeks out businesses that facilitate the adoption of digital assets, including stablecoins, by integrating blockchain networks into existing financial frameworks.
